lessons_used: Adding new screens (new_screen) was helpful, winning 4 tests (+15.4%, +6.4%, +11.4%, +7.9%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 3 showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen info updates (wait_info) were helpful, winning 3 tests (+5.0%, +5.7%, +4.1%), though 1 hurt performance (-6.0%) and 5 showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) were helpful in 1 test (+7.0%), but 2 hurt performance (-3.7%, -3.8%) and 1 showed no clear effect.
Redesigns (redesign) and step reordering (reorder) hurt performance in 1 test each (-7.5% and -3.8% respectively) and showed no clear effect in all other tests.
Copy changes, hints, notifications, and new flows showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins (e.g., predicting +3.0% vs +15.4% measured, +0.0% vs +7.0% measured) and overestimated changes that hurt performance or had no clear effect.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Path Discovery Screen
candidates.change: Insert a interactive pet path preview screen right after the story screen to let users test path choices visually before committing.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a 76.2% conversion with a high mean time (514s), indicating hesitation when selecting a path.

new_path_discovery.headline: Discover Your Ideal Desktop Companion Experience
new_path_discovery.body: Select how you want your pet to live on your desktop: casual companion, active assistant, or playful friend.

guard.reason: Adding a new path discovery screen inside onboarding without removing steps is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Targeting step with high hesitation time using high-performing new_screen format.

candidates.title: Account Sign-In Data Safety Verification Screen
candidates.change: Add an explicit data safety and account verification screen before sign-in options to clarify pet progress saving.
candidates.why: Support receives 8 emails specifically reporting pets missing or reset after signing in again.

new_account_safety.headline: Keep Your Companion Safe
new_account_safety.body: Signing in ensures your pet data, custom looks, and memories are backed up permanently to your account.

guard.reason: screen 'new_account_safety' is not part of onboarding (new screens are named new_..., and may not look like payment, account, sign-up or settings screens)

candidates.title: Reorder Sign-In After Pet Customization
candidates.change: Move sign-in to take place after pet selection and customization so users invest in their pet before creating an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently happens before pet creation, causing early friction (75.8% conversion).

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to occur after pet adoption is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Reordering flows historically carries risk, though sign_in reorders had minor success.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Companion Preview Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate layout into a two-column interactive summary showing real-time customization options.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the longest mean dropoff time (1017s) and 3 support emails report custom pet generation errors.

adoption_certificate.headline: Meet Your New Companion
